summary: fix(settings): match the timeout description to its Fluent markup
description:
The 'timeout' variant of the Pair2 Supplicant TimeoutAndCancel test expected a
description without the <b> tags that both the component fallback and en.ftl
contain. getByText then failed because the markup splits the text node. The
'canceled' variant in the same table already includes the tags, so this makes
the two entries agree.

The drift guard above these cases is it.skip, so nothing caught the mismatch.
